spots.name: Christopher's Prime and Sonoma Wine Bar
Temple Square
spots.blurb: The downtown church headquarters block with gardens, the Tabernacle and visitor centers, lit up nightly for the holidays.
spots.blurbEs: La manzana de la sede de la iglesia en el centro, con jardines, el Tabernáculo y centros de visitantes, iluminada cada noche en las fiestas.

spots.name: Church History Museum
spots.blurb: A free museum of Latter-day Saint history and art across from the west gates of Temple Square.
spots.blurbEs: Un museo gratuito de historia y arte de los Santos de los Últimos Días, frente a las puertas oeste de Temple Square.

spots.name: City Creek Center
spots.blurb: A downtown shopping center on Main Street, a short walk from Temple Square.
spots.blurbEs: Un centro comercial en Main Street, en el centro, a poca distancia a pie de Temple Square.

spots.name: Utah's Hogle Zoo
spots.blurb: Salt Lake City's zoo on the east side of town, about 15 minutes from downtown.
spots.blurbEs: El zoológico de Salt Lake City, en el lado este de la ciudad, a unos 15 minutos del centro.
